Aquaplaning.question: The _____ was Loss of traction due to water buildup under tires.
Aquaplaning.fact: Aquaplaning or hydroplaning by the tires of a road vehicle, aircraft or other wheeled vehicle occurs when a layer of water builds between the wheels of the vehicle and the road surface, leading to a loss of traction that prevents the vehicle from responding to control inputs.
